title: lathyrus brachycalyx subsp. zionis
intro: Lathyrus brachycalyx subsp. zionis, commonly known as Zion pea, is a rare and endemic species of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive compounds. The health benefits of Lathyrus brachycalyx subsp. zionis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing and antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
